lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal structure of Nd₂Al₄Si₆ (Nd(AlSi)₂, space group I4₁/a, No. 143) has 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Al centers with 14 neighbors, Nd centers with 20 neighbors, and Si centers with 8 neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Si 8-vertex polyhedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al 14-vertex and Si 8-vertex polyhedra.
